description: This file defines the base class for the WLAN hardware abstraction layer (HAL) in the prplMesh project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and macros related to WLAN hardware interaction, event handling, and radio information management.

classes.name: base_wlan_hal
classes.description: Abstract base class for WLAN hardware abstraction layer, providing interface methods for WLAN operations and event processing.

methods.name: ~base_wlan_hal
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the base_wlan_hal class.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attach to WLAN hardware/middleware, possibly in non-blocking mode.

methods.name: refresh_radio_info
methods.description: Refresh internal radio and VAPs information from hardware.

methods.name: get_vap_status
methods.description: Get status of VAPs based on BSS info list.

methods.name: update_mld_status
methods.description: Update MLD status based on BSS info list.

methods.name: is_filtered_event
methods.description: Check if an event opcode should be filtered.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Get the type of HAL instance.

methods.name: get_ext_events_fd
methods.description: Get external events file descriptor at specified index.

methods.name: get_ext_events_fds
methods.description: Get vector of external events file descriptors.

methods.name: unique_file_descriptors
methods.description: Indicate if file descriptors are unique per instance.

methods.name: get_vap_id_with_bss
methods.description: Get VAP ID using BSS interface name.

methods.name: get_bss_color_bitmap
methods.description: Convert uint64 to BSS color bitmap string.

methods.name: get_uint64_from_bss_string
methods.description: Convert BSS color bitmap string to uint64.

methods.name: is_BSS_monitored
methods.description: Check if BSS is monitored based on configuration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set a parameter in the interface.
